topic: Fixed Board Layout Live And Synced
currentGoal: Ship the large-field board layout fix: use more of the play area before shrinking tiles, keep the field fixed under mouse hold, preserve smooth performance, get the change live, and sync it to the Mac mini.

sessionOutcome.latestCodeCommitMessage: Fix fixed board layout for large fields

workCompleted: Expanded large-field board layout into a fixed viewport that uses more of the open play area before shrinking tiles.
Added a board content inset so tiles sit inside the play panel instead of touching or bleeding under its frame.
Reserved desktop space for the trigger feed, weather badge, and right command rail when the board is in expanded mode.
Disabled mouse-hold board panning while keeping touch panning available for mobile and tablet large-field access.
Kept zoom centered on the fixed board instead of introducing mouse-driven pan offsets.
Biased future field expansion toward the shorter axis so large fields use space better before tile shrink pressure kicks in.
Pushed commit aec29d2 to origin/master and verified the public site serves the new production asset.
Synced the Mac mini to aec29d2 through GitHub and verified `npm run build` on the Mac.
